question: Can a pre-birth parent determine a relative sign at the four-knot close, and which readers can see it?
inputs: Three old even-parity parents in a ring, their allowed old words, their holdings, and the loose distinctions named in the proposed close.
A four-parent control and an unsigned or mixed comparison, with the same value probabilities.
forbidden_inputs: The sign of the finished pattern, a choice from numeric labels, future births, or the winning table as an input to the rule.
Treating an externally supplied preparation, change read, or write outside the reader as ordinary access.
primary_observable: Derive the allowed change invisible to each individual parent from the old relation. Apply the sign of its loose value at the change. Compare the three old parents, their product at the close, the scope of the changes, and all outcome probabilities under the declared reader alternatives.
control: The close with the change/sign removed, an ordinary mixture at the same probabilities, relabelling, and one larger fixture with the same parent symmetry. Independent check compares a relative phase, an overall sign, sequential changes, and a free reader on its two named distinctions.
resource_budget: One process per exact calculation, one mathematical family and named controls, pilot each computation, at most a few minutes per script and 1 GiB of working memory. No sweep of the old census.
first_executable_signal: List the eight old words, the candidate invisible changes, the signs of the closed questions, and one actually distinguishable signed versus unsigned read, or the first access obstruction.
stop_rule: Stop at the triangle of parents and the stipulated four-parent control after resolving the sign and the reader separately. Preserve any nonunique choice or control failure.
nonclaims: A general sign law for all growth
A quantum read from the ordinary value statistics
Physical time from the order in which operators are written
prior_exposure: Earlier answers and example data were public. The two candidates and their numerical predictions were reasoned out before activation. This is an open exploration, with independent mathematical checks.
